sampling_frame: The six suites in the previously frozen 4302-item plan; MMLU prompts rebuilt zero-shot from pinned raw questions.
sampling_method: Sort each suite by content-token length, divide into ten equal-count bins, choose minimum SHA256(seed:suite:id) within each bin.
content_token_caveat: Content only; excludes chat template and generation prefix. Actual request token counts must be verified before sending.
